_comment: David R. Mayhew's lists of important congressional enactments for the 80th-92nd Congress (1947-72), hand-extracted from Table 4.1 of Divided We Govern (Enactments_1947_1990.docx, pp. 52-73): one row per list entry. The site holds public laws only from 1973, so these entries are not matched to law pages and carry no passage votes; Mayhew gives a title and usually a year, never a date or Public Law number. 'president' is who held the office when the law was enacted (the Congress's president; the 88th is split by hand at Kennedy's death, 1963-11-22). 'kind': law = a signed public law (counted); overridden = enacted over the president's veto (not counted as signed); treaty / amendment = a Senate ratification or a constitutional amendment, not a law the president signed (not counted). 'capitals' = printed in capitals, meaning especially important. 'marks': * = from newspaper wrapups ('Sweep One'), # = from retrospective policy analyses ('Sweep Two'). The 93rd Congress on lives in mayhew-major-laws.json.
